observations: Five open unequal arch bays with the chapel supported on the near-central pier.
Square granite colonnades carry the dark timber trusses and terracotta roof.
The terminal portals have a central vehicle arch plus side pedestrian arches and a low shallow roof; no invented readable inscription.
Map steps descend from the western covered walk to the bank. The return-flight layout and absolute elevations are visualization approximations using unchanged standard terrain.
